adjudication.provable_overlap: All three create or compare fixed hand-designed condition/event count tables. C34 already implements and tests a real previous source action/outcome conditional Bayesian predictor with cold-restored memory against appropriate current-only, shuffled-history and learned native/conventional controls. R11 already implements selected-seven-action visible-effect conditional histograms with cold restart and a perfectly matched conventional count estimator.
adjudication.nonoverlap_limit: C34 is a true original-source physical three-action R1 interface with public x/y fields, R11 source-only authored seven-action DoorKey cues, and ACC138 real full MiniGrid seven-action public-front change prediction. They are not the same operational interface or mathematical hypothesis; combined historical results do not prove impossibility of all novel dynamic memory architectures.
adjudication.reason: Current evidence only establishes retrospective, mixed, model-dependent predictive utility. No source-native policy decisions, true positive rewards, true unfamiliar transfer, causal effect attribution, independent new-world cohort, matched whole-life compute or ownership permission.
